package catalogclient

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

func (client Client) GetRuntimeContext(ctx context.Context, practiceTaskID string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error) {
	return client.getRuntimeContext(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("/internal/catalog/practice-tasks/%s/runtime-context", practiceTaskID))
}

func (client Client) GetPublishedRuntimeContext(ctx context.Context, practiceTaskID string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error) {
	return client.getRuntimeContext(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("/internal/catalog/practice-tasks/%s/published-runtime-context", practiceTaskID))
}

func (client Client) GetRevisionRuntimeContext(ctx context.Context, revisionID string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error) {
	return client.getRuntimeContext(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("/internal/catalog/practice-task-revisions/%s/runtime-context", revisionID))
}

func (client Client) GetRevisionEvaluationContext(ctx context.Context, revisionID string) (*domain.PracticeTaskEvaluationContext, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("practice task orchestrator url is empty")
	}
	endpoint := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + fmt.Sprintf("/internal/catalog/practice-task-revisions/%s/evaluation-context", revisionID)
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if client.InternalToken != "" {
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	}
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("practice task evaluation context request failed: %s", response.Status)
	}
	var payload domain.PracticeTaskEvaluationContext
	if err := json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &payload, nil
}

func (client Client) getRuntimeContext(ctx context.Context, path string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("practice task orchestrator url is empty")
	}

	endpoint := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + path
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if client.InternalToken != "" {
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	}

	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()

	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("practice task catalog request failed: %s", response.Status)
	}

	var payload domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext
	if err := json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for index := range payload.PracticeTaskMilestones {
		targets, err := domain.NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(payload.PracticeTaskMilestones[index].LearningTargets)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid practice task milestone learning targets: %w", err)
		}
		payload.PracticeTaskMilestones[index].LearningTargets = targets
	}
	return &payload, nil
}

func (client Client) httpClient() *http.Client {
	if client.HTTPClient != nil {
		return client.HTTPClient
	}
	return &http.Client{Timeout: 15 * time.Second}
}
